This suggests the Academy published info about his faculty status, not that he worked *for* the Academy. Similarly for Polish Medical Association. So I will exclude them as employers. 'Royal College of Physicians' gave an honorary fellowship, not a job. 'Reading Heart Study Group' is a research group he collaborated with, likely part of the University of Reading. 'Departments' are parts of universities. 'Medical University of Warsaw' is where he studied, not necessarily worked (unless residency counts as working, which it does). So the main missing ones are 'University of Warsaw' and 'University Hospital of Warsaw'. Wait, D2S9 says 'joined the University of Warsaw as a lecturer'. That is work.
